summary.en: A line is typed, the typist hesitates and deletes the tail, then types the real words faster; a highlighter bar settles under them.
summary.zh: 先打出一句平庸的话，犹豫、退格删掉后半句，再更快地打出真正的说法，底下铺一道荧光笔。

fits: A claim made by correcting a plainer one ("not a draft, the cut you meant"); a search or command being refined; copy built on a negation.
notFor: Plain titles with nothing to correct (use type-enter); lines over about 30 characters (16 in Chinese); more than once a film (a second correction reads as a stammer).

intent.en: A small drama of hesitate, reject, declare: the viewer sees the plain word thrown out and the real claim typed faster, so the claim reads as a decision.
intent.zh: 一出“犹豫、否定、宣言”的小戏：观众看着平庸的说法被删掉、真正的卖点被更快地打出来，主张读成一个决定。

content.en: Three slots on one line: the start that stays, the wrong ending (typed then deleted) and the right ending; ≤ 30 chars in all.
content.zh: 同一行的三个槽：保留的开头、打出又删掉的错误结尾、正确结尾；合计 ≤ 16 字。

fits.zh: 用改掉一个平庸说法来亮出主张（“不是草稿，是你想要的那一版”）；一条搜索或命令被改准；否定式文案。

notFor.zh: 没什么可改的普通标题（用 type-enter）；超过约 30 个字符（中文 16 字）的句子；一支片两次以上（改两次口是口吃）。

pairs.note: already ends with a highlighter bar; do not add another mark

en: It depends on sound: key clicks on every character and a lower backspace; silent, it is just a subtitle machine.
Keep the monospace face (or one cell per character), or the line reflows as it types.
zh: 强依赖声音：键击声逐字对齐、退格音更低；无声就只剩字幕机。
保持等宽字体（或每字一个格），否则边打边重排、像抽搐。

upstream.name: 误删重打
upstream.summary: 打字机 error-retype——误删重打的"改口"三幕剧：打出平庸词 → 犹豫 → 退格删掉 → 更快打出卖点词
upstream.use: slogan/卖点字卡、否定式文案；文字自带时间性的入场

overlaps.note: also reveals a line character by character, through scrambled glyphs and without a correction
a plain title entrance; use it unless the correction is the point
